objects.name: Analytic 2226
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies rapid sequential Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol connection attempts to the same field device Internet Protocol (IP) address across different protocol ports from a single source not in the approved control server list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
